## Architecture
Packing report builder: read orders.csv, filter orders, normalize SKU, sum units per SKU, compute cartons, write packing-report.csv.

## Path & Variable Directory
- input: orders.csv (columns order_id,sku,units,status)
- output: packing-report.csv (columns sku,units,cartons; rows sorted by sku)

## Hard Constraints
- Include an order only when status is exactly "ready"; exclude "cancelled" and "hold".
- Normalize SKU: lowercase, then replace each hyphen or space with an underscore; keep existing underscores.
- Sum units per normalized SKU.
- A carton holds 4 units; cartons = units divided by 4, rounded up to a whole carton.
- Rejected approach: including held orders.

## Completed & Verified
- Packing report rules settled and saved in system_state.
- Input orders.csv is ready.

## Active State
Rules settled; orders.csv ready; packing report not yet produced.

## Next Step
Produce packing-report.csv from orders.csv using the decisions saved in system_state.

Decisions: include only status exactly "ready" (cancelled and hold excluded; including held orders was rejected). SKU normalized by lowercasing and replacing each hyphen or space with an underscore, existing underscores kept. Units summed per normalized SKU; cartons hold 4 units, rounded up. Output packing-report.csv with columns sku,units,cartons sorted by sku. Handoff: next session produces the report from the saved state and log; the rules are settled.
